title: THE SMG STARTS ON ITS OWN KEY
why: With no gun plan of his own (a fresh save, which player 2 most often has, since Equip on MY LOADOUT writes no pin) and the SMG in his hands with any second gun stowed, the raid started with the SMG on key 1, key 2 empty showing its ghost, and 2 did nothing, though the Undercroft floor showed the SMG on 2. The raid start asked for the class key only when the belt cell there was vacant or already showed that gun, and the unpinned belt showed the stowed gun on key 2. Proven in headless Chromium: SMG in hand and Sniper stowed started as {0:gun_smg, 7:gun_sniper} on key 1; with the change it starts as {1:gun_smg, 7:gun_sniper} on key 2, and Sniper/SMG, Pistol/Magnum and Rifle/Pistol start exactly as before. RANDOM KIT and BEST KIT pin every gun and were never hit; the DEMO random kit was hit the same way (an SMG with a Magnum stowed started as SMG key 1, Magnum key 2) and now starts on his table (Magnum key 1, SMG key 2). A key table of his own was hit too (SMG first in it, a Pistol in his hands started on key 1, not key 2) and now matches the Undercroft. Now, at the raid start only, a gun in his hands takes its own class key whenever no key of his holds it.
now: With an SMG in your hands and a second gun stowed, the raid now starts with the SMG on its own key 2, as the Undercroft shows it.
